Ally Chen: Heads upAcme's VR team wants a concrete SIEM-ready audit bundle for SIG review. They want admin actions, retention proof, and a sample export. Need it by EOD Fri.
Samir Patel: I can assemble a POC: synthetic admin_activity lines (7 days), a CloudWatch->Kinesis->S3 export sample, and an NDJSON SIEM feed. Do they require WORM/object-lock proof and checksums?
Maya Lopez: Yes to object-lock proof and chain-of-custody. Also include an example alert for tamper detection and who accessed the logs.
Ally Chen: They specifically asked to see role-based events (api key create, key rotate, model deploy), 90+ day retention enforcement, and an export ready for their SIEM ingestion.
Samir Patel: Current infra: hosted audit S3 uses Object Lock with GOVERNANCE and 365d retention. For Dedicated we can enable Object Lock or show on-prem WORM options. I'll include verification commands.
Maya Lopez: Important: redact any customer IDs. Provide a short section describing anonymization and which fields are redacted.
Contracts (Legal): We'll need a signed manifest and a chain-of-custody checklist. Confirm no PII and get an internal approver before sending.
Samir Patel: Draft bundle contents: admin_activity.jsonl (synthetic), siem_feed.ndjson (normalized), retention_manifest.txt (sha256 sums), README.txt (pipeline + verification steps), alert_example.json (tamper alert), verify_manifest.sh (checksums).
Ally Chen: Timeline can we still hit EOD Fri?
Samir Patel: Yes. I'll build today, post for internal review Thu AM. Maya/Legal can review Thu.
Maya Lopez: I'll review Thu morning. Add a small playbook entry: what to do if checksum mismatch and escalation steps.
Samir Patel: Adding runbook snippet and a CloudWatch->SNS alert rule example. Quick sample commands I'll include:
```
aws s3api get-object-lock-configuration --bucket redwood-audit-bucket
aws s3api get-object-retention --bucket redwood-audit-bucket --key path/to/object
sha256sum admin_activity.jsonl > admin_activity.sha256
```
Samir Patel: Example synthetic event line:
{"ts":"2025-08-10T14:12:03Z","actor":"user:alice","action":"create_api_key","resource":"token/service-123","result":"success","request_id":"req-9a7b"}
Contracts (Legal): I'll prepare the signature template and chain-of-custody checklist. Add an email log snippet showing who uploaded the bundle to the secure workspace.
Ally Chen: Great please @here when uploaded so I can forward to Acme.
